simple.meaning: אֶרְאֵל (ʼerʼêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a hero (collectively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶרְאֵל (H691) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֶרְאֵל (H691) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֶרְאֵל (ʼerʼêl) / H691 is traced through Isaiah 33:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H691. erel [ אֶרְאֵל ] noun [masculine] (form & meaning dubious see below) — only in אֶרְאֶלָּם Isa 33:7 ; Ges אַרְאֵלִם heroes ; compare Thes Kn Che; Hi אֲרִאֵלָם ; compare De, who derives from אֲרִיאֵל , literally = lion of God , collective with suffix, & translated their heroes ; name, of a people from אֲרִיאֵל = Zion Nbr Ath. 1886, p. 400 compare Say ib. 466 ; Ew אַרְאָל = אַרְעָל trembling , compare Di. Brd proposes הילילו 'cry pitifully.' ᵑ9 ᵑ6 and others read some form of ירא ᵐ5 ראה, . Wholly uncertain. II. ארה ( burn , compare Arabic , whence hearth ; Ew § 163 g and others see below)
